targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT
    'AFCA' AS customer_name,
    licname,
    unitofmeasuretype,
    prepayquantity,
    prepayquantity AS "Contracted",
    usagequantity,
    usagequantity - prepayquantity AS Overage,
    startdate::text,
    enddate::text,
    to_char(date_trunc('month', startdate + (enddate - startdate) / 2), 'FMMonth, YYYY') AS "Month, Year"
  FROM suboverviewdata
  WHERE $__timeFilter(enddate)
    AND ($var_alldata = true OR (usagequantity - prepayquantity) > 0)
    AND (
      licname = 'Genesys Cloud Collaborate User' OR
      licname = 'Genesys Cloud Communicate User' OR
      licname LIKE '%Genesys Cloud CX%'
    )
    AND licname NOT LIKE '%Add-On%'
) AS subquery
WHERE
  ('${partner:raw}' IN ('All','') OR customer_name LIKE REPLACE('${partner:raw}', '\\', '') || '/%')
  AND ('${customerName}' = 'All' OR customer_name = '${customerName}')
ORDER BY enddate, licname;
